scope: Production parameterized historical backtest composition; no live execution

legacy_ownership_audit.contract: Entry intent is the completed candle close. SL/TP are strategy distances from that plan price. No fill authority.

Sizing floors monetary budget / stop-distance dollar risk. Lifecycle caps requested contracts. Independent simulation separately evaluates sizing. TradePlan.risk_amount is points times contracts, not authoritative NQ dollar risk.
Configured submission must explicitly accept before independent simulation. Signal, position, sizing, risk and final execution gates remain authoritative.
PAPER market fill uses plan price plus adverse configured entry slippage. Factory configures 0.25 points. Planned SL/TP remain unchanged. Position manager consumes the actual fill and quantity.

Separate zero-cost plan-price entry. Future high/low SL/TP trigger, stop first when both touch. Exit at the planned level. Quantity times point value times signed price change. END_OF_DATA uses last-close valuation, separated from completed trades by Sprint 05. No account-risk feedback.

Historical session supplies close only. Position manager uses executed entry and current close; crossing the planned stop/target closes at that close. Lifecycle synchronizes PAPER position/protections/OCO and propagates the outcome. Position status feeds the next strategy call before risk evaluation.

Existing reusable authority. Balance is starting balance plus cumulative realized PnL; equity additionally includes open marked PnL. Lifecycle-supplied realized close PnL takes precedence over local fallback calculation. Not wired in current historical factory.

Existing reusable authority supports injected clock. Daily PnL adds only changes in cumulative realized PnL. Drawdown uses peak marked equity minus equity, not merely realized balance. Reset uses MarketHoursServiceV2.trading_day_for, retaining cumulative realization baseline. Historical factory currently leaves it disconnected.

Static profile balance and zero daily PnL/drawdown. The lifecycle can override daily PnL/drawdown from a bound account-state manager, but this composition has none. Must be replaced with current canonical state in the new path.

Lifecycle writes projections of its position outcome. Journal accepts supplied PnL and explicit exit time, but open time currently uses wall clock. Existing historical composition has trade history but no TradeJournalV2. A historical binding must supply deterministic event times and extra provenance/cost/account-after metadata.
Reports starting balance as balance/equity. Does not realize a cash ledger on close; must not be selected as historical realized-account authority.

Frozen native UTC end-time mapping, Chicago session eligibility, per-contract isolation and retained excluded observations. New accounting must consume only eligible chronological prices and never resolve an old contract position with a new contract price.

resolved_contract.question: Intrabar historical stop/target triggers versus lifecycle close-price triggers
resolved_contract.reason: Making the simulator's intrabar close authoritative also changes the pre-risk ACTIVE POSITION strategy input. Preserving that input instead retains a position after the intrabar trade has closed. The request calls for both preserved historical stop-first behavior and unchanged pre-risk decisions except risk corrections.
resolved_contract.resolution: Sprint 07R explicitly authorizes intrabar OHLC exits, stop before target, immediate position-state synchronization and causally explained position/risk feedback differences.

read_only_probe.limitation: Probe changes only in-memory lifecycle marking at observed OHLC triggers. It is not an implemented canonical accounting path or performance certification.
